summary: Kept migrated reserving-class indexes usable without a slow sidecar rescan or frontend rewrite.
details: Migration, frontend, Python API, and macro index producers now use the same portable minimal schema and payload normalization.
Valid current indexes no longer gain sidecar-only details such as origin_labels when opened.
Machine-local folder paths are response-only, so drive-letter and UNC aliases do not change persisted index content or break another frontend.

Index rebuilds use atomic replacement and a shared-drive-visible update lock, and interrupted imports rebuild before returning an error so another computer does not receive a stale current-version index.
Packaged and separately installed Python APIs now resolve the same canonical index implementation.
The canonical index version was advanced so indexes emitted by an intermediate case-sensitive producer are rebuilt once with filesystem-preserved project and reserving-class identity.
